body:
Source: GitHub issue #734 (bug, security, tokenomics, P1-high; class trust boundary). Re-verified on main @ 5343b84b: packages/quartermaster/lib/registry.mjs:303-311 effectiveFamilyCapacity keys a direct seat `direct:${normalizeProviderName(member.provider)}` and a gateway seat `gateway:${member.transport}`, so a direct-anthropic seat and an anthropic model behind a gateway count as two independent families. A cross-model-trust-root group with quorum 2 whose members are {adapter 'claude-code', transport 'subscription:anthropic-max', provider 'anthropic', directAuth true} and {adapter 'opencode', model 'anthropic/claude-opus-5', transport 'gateway:opencode-go', provider 'anthropic'} validates clean, while the same two seats both direct are rejected with "only 1 independent family". The consuming gate (packages/prosecute/lib/cross-model.mjs) reduces approvals to a Set of normalized providers, so those two seats are one family there: the registry accepts a group that is under-satisfiable, or, with a third-provider author, records two same-vendor approvals as cross-family diversity.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/quartermaster`: lib/registry.mjs (registry validation; effectiveFamilyCapacity and the rule that uses it around :379-395), lib/provider.mjs (normalizeProviderName), lib/route-job.mjs, lib/escalate.mjs, lib/channels.mjs, lib/load.mjs. Consumer: packages/fleet imports quartermaster (packages/fleet/lib/quartermaster.mjs, config.mjs, adapters); fleet tests packages/fleet/test/quartermaster.test.mjs and packages/fleet/test/quartermaster-skipped-ledger.test.mjs must stay green. Tests: `npm test -w packages/quartermaster` from the worktree root. packages/quartermaster/test/registry-validation.test.mjs is NOT a rail and may gain cases.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. effectiveFamilyCapacity counts connected components under the relation "same family": two members are the same family if they share a normalized declared provider (whatever their transport), OR they are both gateway seats on the same transport string (the existing §6 rule). A gateway member with no declared provider joins only its transport's component. Implement as a pure function over the member list (union-find or equivalent), exported for tests as `familyCapacity(members)`; effectiveFamilyCapacity delegates to it or is renamed, with every call site updated.
2. The rejection message for the under-capacity case states that a gateway seat and a direct seat on the same provider are one family, alongside the existing gateway and same-provider wording.
3. Regression guard: two direct seats on different providers still count 2; two gateway seats on one transport still count 1; two gateway seats on different transports with different declared providers still count 2; the reference registry still validates.
4. Documentation: update `packages/quartermaster/README.md` and make the SAME edit by hand in `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/quartermaster.mdx` (hand-maintained mirror; never regenerate). State that a gateway seat counts as the same family as any other seat declaring the same provider.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 The issue's direct-anthropic + gateway-anthropic quorum-2 trust-root group is rejected by registry validation with the family-capacity message. verify: `node --test packages/quartermaster/test/gateway-family.test.mjs`
- AC2 familyCapacity: transitive collapse (gateway A carries provider X, gateway B on the same transport carries provider Y, a direct seat on Y) counts 1. verify: `node --test packages/quartermaster/test/gateway-family.test.mjs`
- AC3 Regression cases from normative 3. verify: `node --test packages/quartermaster/test/gateway-family.test.mjs`
- AC4 Existing quartermaster suite and the fleet consumers green. verify: `npm test -w packages/quartermaster && node --test packages/fleet/test/quartermaster.test.mjs packages/fleet/test/quartermaster-skipped-ledger.test.mjs`
- AC5 Docs updated in both places. verify: `grep -c "same provider" packages/quartermaster/README.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/quartermaster.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC6 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally)

OUT OF SCOPE: any change to packages/prosecute (cross-model.mjs is the consumer whose semantics this aligns to), route-job and escalation behaviour, provider normalization rules.
title: quartermaster: a gateway seat and a direct seat on the same provider count as one family
